decisions.reason: This diversification into healthcare and hospitality recruitment lies far from the core ship management business and the website reports no results, so it may fall short of aspirations, but it reuses the firm's existing crewing infrastructure and the large firm's slack lets it be carried for now.
Superyacht crew recruitment sits close to the firm's core crew management competence and costs little to run, so the firm is likely to keep it even though no results are reported.
The Smart Academy quickly grew to six partner institutions, which meets aspirations and supports crew training and development in the core business.
FuelEU compliance is mandatory for the vessels it manages and the firm met the monitoring plan deadline for all of them, so this service performs above aspiration and is essential.
The dashboard is integrated into the firm's PAL ship management software and supports a growing regulatory need, so there is no shortfall that would trigger dropping it.
The cost simulator is an integrated companion tool within the FuelEU compliance offering, keeping it costs little, and it adds value for clients.
